bio_am: Ծնած է Երեւան՝ 1863-ին։ Խանասորի մարտիկ, ինկաւ 1914-ին՝ Պայազէտի գրաւումէն ժամեր առաջ։
bio_en: Galust Aloyan, known as Toros, was born in 1863 into a wealthy Yerevan family; after the gymnasium he chose not to go to university but trained as a gunsmith at the imperial arms factory in Tula. One of the oldest ARF members, he worked in Persia in the 1890s and was a fighter in the Khanasor expedition of 1897. Arrested in Yerevan in 1902, in July 1903 he led thousands of protesters against the seizure of the church properties from the Yerevan prelacy to Etchmiadzin. He was killed by a treacherous Kurdish bullet two hours before the capture of Bayazet in 1914, after 25 years of service.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Years 1863-1914 from the story title.
